description: Private-line complaint negotiation closed-loop evaluation. Each case drives the negotiation prompt interfaces in message order: Task-T generation (fromData/fromText) -> server validation (missing-slot detection) -> Negotiation-T propose generation -> server outbound propose validation -> client inbound propose validation -> client fill + accept generation -> server inbound accept validation -> second Task-T validation. Channels: fromData feeds structured JSON (every key maps to one slot value) together with the task schema; fromText feeds natural language. Slot extraction and all validation interfaces run the SDK pipeline (rule gate + semantic LLM call), with the JSON schema passed on every generate/validate call. Slot requiredness is enforced at the validation gate (task_schema required list), not at generation: a prompt with missing required slots is still renderable, so negotiation can ask for exactly those gaps.

任务对象.description: 专线业务对象标识，用于定位被投诉的专线业务
任务对象.x-a2at-value-constraint: 专线名称：网络侧EMS网管的专线对象标识。接入端口名称：网络侧EMS网管的接入端口名称，格式为：网元名称+单板号+单板型号+端口号。接入端口资源ID：网络侧EMS网管的接入端口资源对象标识。三者提供其一。

投诉分类.description: 投诉场景分类，标识专线故障的现象类型
投诉分类.x-a2at-value-constraint: 取值仅限两种场景之一：专线中断（业务完全不可用）、专线质差（业务可用但质量劣化）。

问题发生时间.description: 故障或投诉现象的发生时间
问题发生时间.x-a2at-value-constraint: 可选参数，允许为空，为空不构成校验错误；时间格式建议为 ISO 8601（如 2026-05-11T08:21:46Z）。

OSS侧事件流水号.description: OSS侧的专线业务投诉工单流水号
OSS侧事件流水号.x-a2at-value-constraint: OSS侧事件流水号：填写OSS侧的专线业务投诉工单流水号，格式为 event-id-开头的事件标识。

投诉详情.description: 专线用户对业务投诉的描述，以及OSS侧的预处理信息
投诉详情.x-a2at-value-constraint: 可选参数，允许为空，为空不构成校验错误；自由文本描述，无格式约束。

negotiation_phrasing.propose_relationship: 以上参数均为必选，缺少无法启动诊断
negotiation_phrasing.from_text_accept_suffix: 信息已完整，可以启动诊断。
